description: The page failed to load the application and instead displayed a WebGL compatibility error: 'Meridian Bay needs WebGL, and this browser cannot provide it.' No 'Click to explore Meridian Bay' button was found.

issues.name: WebGL Compatibility Error - Application Fails to Load
issues.description: Expected: The page should load and display a button labelled 'Click to explore Meridian Bay'. Actual: The page shows an alert message 'Meridian Bay needs WebGL, and this browser cannot provide it. This browser could not create a WebGL context. Try a browser with hardware acceleration enabled.' and no other content is visible.
reproductionSteps: Observe the error message regarding WebGL.
